title: California Storms: Technology helps rescue effort
description: Spc. John Young-Ahuna, a friendly force tracking mission support specialist with the California National Guard's Joint Operations Center, describes the tracking devices and interface system being used by the Guard and partner agencies during the Montecito, California, mudslide response, Jan. 11, 2018. Young-Ahuna prepositioned in Santa Barbara, California, and worked with first responders at the mudslide's incident command post throughout the week. (U.S. Air National Guard video by Senior Airman Crystal Housman)
keywords: mudslide, disaster response, data, Geospatial, DSCA, JOC, Domestic Operations, Montecito, nanotracker, search and rescue, rescue, technology, Southern California
